_meta.description: Evaluation rubric used by eval_agent. Each context defines a weighted scoring formula. Weights per context must sum to 1.0.

metrics.win_rate: Proportion of games won in the test batch
metrics.prize_efficiency: Prizes taken per turn relative to opponent
metrics.ko_rate: Rate of successful KOs relative to attacks made
metrics.logic_delta: Improvement in decision quality vs. previous agent version (from reasoning_log diff)

contexts.aggro_test: Fast-aggro mirror matchup — rewards explosive damage and prize racing
contexts.meta_test: Broad meta simulation — rewards consistency and adaptive play
contexts.micro_patch: Small targeted improvement pass — rewards logic quality over raw wins
